topPRs.title: fix(configs): mark mode, metal and zora as not governed by optimism
topPRs.author: OptimismBot
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Sets `governed_by_optimism = false` for every chain whose `ProxyAdminOwner` is not the standard L1PAO but which was still marked as OP-governed. #1363 synced these owners with onchain state and flagged that the governance flag was now stale.

| chain | ProxyAdminOwner | standard L1PAO |
|---|---|---|
| mainnet/metal, mainnet/mode, mainnet/zora | `0x4a4962275DF8C60a80d3a25faEc5AA7De116A746` | `0x5a0Aae59D09fccBdDb6C6CcEB07B7279367C3d2A` |
| sepolia/metal, sepolia/mode, sepolia/zora | `0x34478c2eB9018d5A6487BF0440838Cd4238e8cf2` | `0x1Eb2fFc903729a0F03966B917003800b145F56E2` |

All other chains with `governed_by_optimism = true` (op, ink, soneium, unichain, and their Sepolia counterparts) use the standard L1PAO and are unchanged.

The generated `chainList.toml`, `chainList.json` and `CHAINS.md` are updated to match. I edited them by hand because Go isn't available in my environment. The `check-chainlist` CI job will confirm they match codegen output.

Also updates `superchain/extra/addresses/addresses.json` for OP Sepolia (11155420): `SystemConfigOwner` changed onchain from `0xfd1D2e729aE8eEe2E146c033bf4400fE75284301` to `0xDEe57160aAfCF04c34C887B5962D0a69676d3C8B`. This is unrelated to the governance flag, but `check-codegen` reads every chain from L1 and fails until it is synced. CI's codegen output confirmed that the hand-edited `chainList.toml`, `chainList.json` and `CHAINS.md` were already correct.

Prompted by: @sbvegan
